name: Basic Path Drawing Rule
hint_layers: Every panel solution begins at a round node.
The line must end at a rounded endpoint and cannot cross itself.
Other symbols add extra constraints on top of this basic rule.
solution: Draw a continuous non-self-intersecting path from a round start node to a rounded endpoint while satisfying all panel-specific rules.

name: Learning Rules Without Text
hint_layers: The game teaches rules by arranging panels in a sequence.
Compare the simplest panel with the next changed panel.
When a new symbol appears, solve nearby easier examples before jumping to a complex panel.
solution: Infer the rule by solving ordered panel clusters where each new panel changes one constraint at a time.

name: Environmental Clue Panels
hint_layers: Not every rule is inside the grid.
Look around the panel; nearby shapes, branches, shadows, or terrain may encode the missing constraint.
Try translating the observed environmental pattern into the grid path.
solution: Use nearby environmental information as part of the puzzle rule, then draw a path that matches both the panel symbols and the observed pattern.
